positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Backend developer focusing on ingesting data from third parties, structuring the data for usage within the application, and exposing the data for usage via APIs
• Added integration with Snowflake and drove down company costs by adding self-service capabilities allowing customers to visualize and structure data
• Improved proactive monitoring, equipping staff across the organization to be aware of issues and to identify exactly which processes were failing
• Identified and addressed several performance bottlenecks, enabling support of larger customers and decreasing infrastructural costs
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · Data Ingestion · Datadog · PostgreSQL · .NET Framework

positions.title: Principal Software Architect
positions.locationName: Ann Arbor, Michigan, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Provided technical direction across Engineering 
• Collaborated cross-functionality, aligning Engineering with business objectives as well as with other technical-centric departments (ex: Data Science).  Additionally, departments were acting in silos, and I prompted interactions necessary to improve the health of critical projects
• Mentored peers by providing training and context
• Reduced technical complexity, while encouraging investments in several areas critical for company growth
• Contributed to the development of the technical platform, with the objective of providing tools to support others
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Apache Kafka · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Software Architecture · Interpersonal Communication

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.locationName: East Lansing, Michigan, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Supprted a multi-year, multi-team technical effort to consolidate a suite of SaaS products and monolithic applications into a single product built upon microservices.  Led technical direction, guided development teams, and worked closely with Product, Design, Operations, Customer Support, etc.
• Following the acquisition of a competitor, led project to integrate products
• Implemented a number of core components, with a focus on those where security was of greatest importance: authentication, authorization, federation, user management, payment collection, and others
• Guided implementation of Kubernetes and helped assemble a business case for adoption of AWS
• Mentored others and provided tools for Engineering and Operations
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Apache Kafka · Spring Boot · Elastic Stack (ELK) · Cassandra · Hands-on Technical Leadership
